text:
alex: quick heads-up — we're seeing a pattern where requests signed with service-account keys get routed to the cheap pool and then hit project-level quotas. causes some silent failures in customer dashboards.
priya: interesting. are those keys missing project metadata on ingress or is the router dropping it?
alex: looks like ~80% missing project header. upstream SDKs sometimes omit project when minting sa keys. we currently fallback to org for billing but the quota enforcement happens at project layer and rejects.
jen: can we add a conservative fallback in the router to map unscoped sa keys to org-default-project before hitting quota check? that would avoid noisy errors for many users.
samir: that'll hide some real misconfigurations though. i'd prefer surfacing in console + telemetry first. e.g., a new metric: inbound.auth.effective_principal with tags {header_project, resolved_project, fallback_used}.
kevin: +1 for traceability. operationally: quick fallback in router with a flag (feature flag: router.fallback_to_org_project) enabled for 10% of traffic while we build observability.
alex: plan: 1) emit metric as samir suggested 2) implement flagged fallback (only for hosted API) 3) console UX: show "Effective billing project" on key details page and a hint when fallback used 4) roll flag to 100% after 48h and no regressions.
priya: sample code for header we'll rely on: `X-Redwood-Principal: sa:sa-789;origin:client-sdk;project:proj-456;org:org-123`. router should prefer explicit project > cached project mapping > org-default.
jen: what about Dedicated customers with strict tenancy? we should not auto-assign project there. feature flag scope should exclude Dedicated and Private deployments.
kevin: noted. log line for alerts: `quota-alert project=proj-456 pct=92 route=cheap-pool key=sa-789 fallback=true`. ops-bot: QuotaAlert: project proj-456 at 92% - see /alerts/ALERT-9876
alex: for telemetry sampling, let's record one trace per 1000 requests per key, and sample all errors. metrics names: `auth.router.resolve_latency_ms`, `auth.router.resolution_path` (values: explicit/cached/fallback), `auth.router.fallback_count`.
samir: dashboard layout proposal: top-left heatmap of resolution_path by org, center timeseries for fallback_count and quota_denials, bottom list of keys by error-rate with link to key page. i'll sketch a mock and post later.
priya: UX copy for key page hint: "We couldn't find a project attached to this key in the request. The router temporarily used your org default project to avoid quota errors. Please update your SDK or set a project header to ensure correct billing and isolation."
jen: question: when fallback fails (e.g., project not configured) we should return 403 with a distinct error code `ERR_PROJECT_UNRESOLVED` so client-side flows can surface clear remediation steps.
kevin: agreed. add instrumentation to record which clients see ERR_PROJECT_UNRESOLVED so we can prioritize SDK patches.
alex: ok i created TICKET-1289 and assigned priya + samir + jen. milestone = next sprint. will gate rollback config in case Dedicated impacted.
priya: i'll own the console mock and copy.
samir: i'll own the metrics and grafana panel.
jen: i'll do error code + API contract doc and update SDK owners.
kevin: i'll roll the flag and monitor.
alex: thanks all. thumbs up if no objections :+1: 
kevin: :+1:
jen: :+1:
priya: :shipit:
ops-bot: DeployBot: feature flag router.fallback_to_org_project scheduled to canary (10%) on hosted region us-east-1.
